help.intro: A discount only applies once every piece below is set up correctly - use this as a checklist before you publish one.
help.step_1_body: Give it a label, pick a reason, and set the type (percent or fixed amount) and value.
help.step_2_body: Scope decides what the discount can apply to: the whole order, a specific set of products, categories or brands, or the delivery price (shipping).
help.step_3_body: Every scope except "order" and "shipping" needs at least one target - use the target picker to link the products, categories or brands it should apply to. Without one, the discount is saved but matches nothing. A shipping discount may target clients; left without any, it applies to every buyer.
help.step_4_body: Add a minimum order value, restrict it to certain countries, or limit it to an hour and day range. Leave a condition empty to skip it.
help.step_5_body: Start and end dates control when the discount is live. Leave both empty for a discount that is active as soon as it is created.
help.note: Changing a discount's scope replaces its targets for the new scope - the previous scope's targets are cleared, not kept in reserve.

text.reduces_the_delivery_or_return_price: Reduces the delivery or return price. Leave empty to apply it to every buyer.
text.all_must_be_met_for_the: All must be met for the discount to apply. Leave a field empty to drop that condition.
text.no_targets: No targets yet - this discount will not apply to anything.
